findings.location: contract.json prior-invalid policy/shared diagnostics; frontend/src/document/model.ts:71; operations.ts:41
findings.problem: Diagnostic display is capped at64 by issue(). The current newContradiction reads that truncated list. Replacing nodeId:message with structured edge/rule identities alone does not fix acceptance: with64 pre-existing errors, a new contradiction visited afterward never enters the set and can be admitted. This independently extends Terra1 diagnostic-identity finding.
findings.required_fix: Keep enforcement violations distinct from the bounded user-facing diagnostic list. Compute all relevant violations within the bounded graph or explicitly fail closed when enforcement analysis is incomplete; never use a silently truncated display list as evidence of no new contradiction. Add a prior-invalid fixture with64 existing errors then a new late-visited opposite-sort/nominal violation, plus unchanged-prior-error control and declaration/node-order permutations.

findings.location: contract.json explicit hole.expected conjunction and destination constraints; operations.ts:29; tests-plan.json PT-012/PT-016
findings.problem: The plan analyzes post-replacement candidates but does not specify the lifetime of explicit hole.expected. replaceSubtree removes the destination hole. A valid hole expected relation[A] under some_test can therefore be replaced with relation[B] and lose the only exact[A] constraint before analysis; PT-012 only checks contradictory holes while still present.
findings.required_fix: Define how explicit destination-hole constraints are enforced during replacement. Capture applicable explicit slot constraints before deleting the hole, check the replacement against them through the shared analysis, and retain any unresolved obligation needed for later completion (or explicitly document and justify different replacement semantics). Do not retain the replaced concrete expression own inferred type as a blanket destination constraint. Test replacing an exact[A] hole under an otherwise generic relation parent with [B], with [A], and with an incomplete relation that is later completed incompatibly, through insertion and paste routes.

concurred_existing_blockers.reason: Distinct operand violations must not collapse into one message-based identity; preserve unchanged-prior-error policy rather than lossy identity mechanics.
Canonical finite propagation domain and fail-closed budget exhaustion are needed to make fixed-point evaluation deterministic and bounded.
dropNode currently publishes select/copy/select before validation. Atomicity snapshot must precede the whole gesture and candidate preparation must not publish.

formal_assessment: The13 new theorem types are model-only and keep prior267 propositions separate (280 inventory total). Product/join/transpose predicates prove their stated narrow exclusions only; declared/nonempty/schema validity remain independent obligations. No theorem should be advertised as whole-checker refinement.
